title: Local-evidence RatsNestPro PCB workflow
description: Compatibility boundary for the legacy decisions/local-evidence Agent kernel. It exposes the professional product shell without claiming enforcement of the five production capability profiles.

supported: schematic, PCB, routing and review workflows
excluded: guaranteed support for arbitrary board classes

constraints: Installed KiCad symbols and footprints are authoritative for library availability.
Model prose cannot override deterministic file, ERC, DRC or routing evidence.
This compatibility profile is transport metadata; the legacy Agent kernel retains its own evidence and capability gates.
evidence_requirements: Official documentation for critical components and interfaces.
Installed KiCad library evidence for symbol and footprint bindings.
Actual filesystem and tool results for release claims.

verification: All reported artifacts must exist on disk.
Unresolved checks must remain visible in the final report.
Independent review is required before a release-ready claim.
acceptance.delivery_policy: Preserve valid editable outputs and disclose unresolved risks. This profile does not upgrade the legacy Agent kernel to the five-profile production capability model.
